judged_text: TopicEmbed.import stores externally supplied feed/scraped content with cook_method raw_html, which Post#cook returns verbatim with no sanitization, and best.html.erb renders it via `raw post.cooked`. Any HTML in an imported item executes as script on the Discourse origin for every visitor of the embed iframe and the imported topic — PollFeed passes CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content) straight through, which even expands <script> entities into live tags — giving a single malicious feed item stored XSS on the forum.

adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly introduces a path where externally sourced HTML is stored and rendered without sanitization. `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/topic_embed.rb), and `Post#cook` returns `raw` verbatim for `raw_html` (app/models/post.rb), bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. The embed UI then renders it with `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). Additionally, the feed importer builds `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and passes it straight into `TopicEmbed.import` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), which can turn encoded tags like `<script>` into executable `<script>` in stored content. This is a verifiable stored-XSS issue introduced/exposed by the diff.
